items.headline: CFTC launches new Innovation Advisory Committee
items.summary: CFTC Commissioner Michael Selig announced the renamed Innovation Advisory Committee will hold its inaugural meeting on August 20 in Washington, D.C., per a Lowenstein Sandler client alert, to advise on technology, law and market-structure issues.

items.headline: Commodity trade finance market forecast to $81bn
items.summary: A newly published market report projects commodity trade finance growing from $59.7bn in 2026 to $81.45bn by 2030, driven by blockchain-based settlement and real-time risk monitoring adoption, per GlobeNewswire/ResearchAndMarkets.

items.headline: US rail freight volumes extend 2026 gains
items.summary: Weekly US rail traffic for the week ending August 1 rose 2.4% year-on-year to 526,410 carloads and intermodal units, with metallic ores/metals and petroleum-related shipments leading commodity gains, per FreightWaves/AAR data.

items.headline: Advisor-led CTRM deployments cut go-live times
items.summary: Industry guidance notes that while in-house CTRM builds can take 12-24+ months and licensed platforms 3-9 months, advisor-led systems can go live in days to weeks, per Mobius Risk Group, reshaping vendor-selection priorities for trading desks.
